purpose: Close frontal upper-half composition concept for stronger parallax; one composite, not yet separated.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / composition redesign. Create ONE new full-color portrait concept mock-up of El Unicornio on his motorcycle, using the supplied approved image as the character, clothing, motorcycle, palette and illustration-style reference. The user found the previous diagonal full-bike view weak for parallax and specifically requests a STRAIGHT ROAD, the character coming STRAIGHT TOWARD THE VIEWER, a MUCH CLOSER camera, and framing the UPPER HALF of the character and bike. Redesign the camera and composition accordingly, preserving the character identity and tone. This is a unified composite mock-up for review, not separated layers yet.

CAMERA AND COMPOSITION: A true head-on frontal tracking shot, camera directly ahead of the motorcycle, centered on its longitudinal axis at about the rider's chest/headlight height. The motorcycle travels upright straight toward the viewer, NOT turning, NOT leaning, NOT viewed from a three-quarter angle. A tight upper-body portrait: the unicorn's full horn, helmet, head, long neck, shoulders, chest, arms and both pink hands are visible. His face is central and LARGE, friendly and readable. The broad chrome handlebars and hands span the lower third and extend toward us; a large round golden headlight and the TOPS of the twin front forks dominate the immediate lower foreground. Show only the upper fuel tank and upper motorcycle assembly. Crop decisively through the bike below the headlight and upper forks at the bottom edge: DO NOT show a complete front wheel, a complete motorcycle, boots, full legs, road contact or a full-body rider. The front wheel may be completely outside the frame. Keep a little sky margin above the horn. Both hands should stay visibly inside the side edges. Use a confident vertical centered silhouette and balanced head-on perspective, with enough breathing room to fit a portrait card illustration.

BACKGROUND: A STRAIGHT desert highway, clearly running away to a SINGLE central vanishing point directly behind the unicorn. No S-curve, bend or diagonal viewpoint. Parallel roadway and markings narrow into the distance and are seen in the gaps beside his upper body and below his arms. Distant red-orange mesas, a few slender cacti near the outer edges, low horizon and open rich blue sky with a few cream faceted clouds. Background has broad restrained shapes and less contrast/detail near the character outline. Warm late-afternoon desert light. Keep the central sky behind his helmet and horn quiet so his silhouette reads. Do not put rock props across the foreground in this version.

CHARACTER: The same endearingly slightly derpy adult humanoid PINK unicorn with long simply faceted equine face and neck, lavender muzzle, small toothy cheerful smile, ONE pearlescent pastel horn, upright pink ears, and a little BANDED pastel rainbow mane emerging behind his BLACK OPEN-FACE HELMET. Helmet has silver edging, a plausible fictional horn port and chin strap. BLACK SUNGLASSES remain. BLACK LEATHER JACKET worn OPEN over his original PALE AQUA TURTLENECK SWEATER with high sage-mint rolled collar and the small unicorn-head emblem at the chest. He must look earnest and delighted, not angry or hyper-macho. Human torso, pink human hands correctly gripping handlebars, natural symmetric riding anatomy. Butter-yellow pants only if a tiny glimpse is naturally visible at the crop, but do not expand framing to include them.

PARALLAX DESIGN: Strong three-plane composition. Far plane: uncluttered straight highway and distant desert. Middle plane: large centered unicorn rider with clear head/shoulder silhouette, upper tank and open visible spaces between arms and torso. Near plane: chrome handlebar assembly, oversized headlight and upper forks clearly closer to the camera, creating a distinct band across the lower image with purposeful overlap in front of the torso. Make the near assembly large and dimensional with a coherent connected construction, but keep the chest emblem and turtleneck readable. Avoid intricate scenery threaded through the bike; reserve clean depth gaps. Crisp rider and headlight; restrained directional motion softness only in distant road verges.

STYLE: Match the reference's rich faceted sculptural low-poly collectible-card illustration, jewel-blue sky, peach-pink skin, mint/aqua sweater, inky leather with amber highlights, warm gold and chrome. Crisp angular forms and expressive lighting, polished loteria-inspired poster artwork. NOT photorealistic, not a raw 3D game screenshot, not smooth generic cartoon. Full-bleed 2:3 portrait approximately 1024 x 1536. No card border, lettering, numbers, stats, watermark or separate panels. The crucial change is TRUE FRONT VIEW and TIGHT UPPER-HALF FRAMING, not merely a straighter road behind the old diagonal pose.
